name: मेनोएतिअस
type: Asteroid · Jupiter Trojan · L5 · Binary secondary
fact: 104-km secondary of the Patroclus-Menoetius binary in the L5 Trojan swarm — nearly equal-mass partner to Patroclus, separated by 680 km. Lucy's 2033-03 encounter will be the first close-up of a Trojan binary system, mapping both partners simultaneously.
bio: Identified as a separate body in 2001 via mutual-events observations. Menoetius (father of Patroclus in Homeric tradition) shares the L5 stable orbit with Patroclus 60° trailing Jupiter. The near-equal-mass binary geometry produces a barycenter that lies outside either body, making Patroclus-Menoetius the largest known close-binary in the Trojan population.
